result.description: The Orchid Loom is a fictional 27-inch ultrawide monitor created for creative work, featuring a 3440x1440 IPS panel, 100Hz refresh rate, and USB-C display input with 65W power delivery. It is positioned for illustration, editing, and office productivity rather than storage or compute hardware. The matte anti-glare screen offers wide viewing angles, factory-calibrated color tuning, and an adjustable stand with tilt, swivel, and height controls. Connectivity includes HDMI, DisplayPort, and a USB hub for accessories. This model emphasizes desktop visibility and ergonomic comfort, making it intentionally distinct from drive and graphics products.
result.title: Orchid Loom 27in Ultrawide Design Monitor
